summary: A suite of Mix operator tasks that automate plugin scaffolding, data lifecycle operations (ONIX import/export, Bokbasen publish/replay, FRT seed/export), token rotation, search quality evaluation, and backfill utilities — the CLI surface for running Barkpark outside the HTTP request cycle.

intentions.title: Reduce plugin authorship friction to near-zero
intentions.evidence: barkpark.plugin.new.ex generates a fully wired plugin skeleton (manifest, entry module, test, schemas dir) that immediately passes Registry discovery and mix test — mirrors the OnixEdit reference layout, no manual registry edit needed. barkpark.gen.plugin.ex is a deprecated shim pointing to the new task.

intentions.title: Make ONIX/Bokbasen publishing operationally recoverable
intentions.evidence: bokbasen.replay.ex lets operators re-enqueue a failed Bokbasen publish or dry-run the ONIX 3.0 XML render + XSD gate without touching the live API. bokbasen.list.ex and bokbasen.status.ex expose submission state and per-book detail. onix.import.ex bulk-ingests ONIX XML feeds as draft book documents.

intentions.title: Keep public-read credentials rotated automatically
intentions.evidence: barkpark.rotate_public_read.ex generates a fresh token weekly (invoked by a systemd timer), writes it 0600 to disk, POSTs it to the Vercel deploy hook, and purges tokens older than 8 days — full credential lifecycle with no manual step.

intentions.title: Gate search quality regressions in CI
intentions.evidence: search.eval.ex runs golden JSONL queries, reports MRR/NDCG@10/zero-hit-rate, and exits non-zero on failure or baseline regression — designed to run in CI as a quality gate.

intentions.title: Serve Barkpark as a CMS backend for non-web clients (game engine)
intentions.evidence: frt.export.ex reads published FRT documents and emits a deterministic, byte-stable SHA-256-pinned JSON artifact keyed by type for a Godot game loader. frt.seed.ex writes the dataset. The determinism contract (canonical_iodata, sorted keys, hash over types only) is explicit so CI can assert content stability.

intentions.title: Maintain ONIX codelist data integrity over time
intentions.evidence: barkpark.codelists.seed.ex populates the EDItEUR codelist registry on first boot; codelists.staleness.ex reports stale entries and triggers revalidation — keeping the ONIX export correct as the codelist standard evolves.

intentions.title: Bridge TypeScript SDK and Elixir plugin types automatically
intentions.evidence: barkpark.plugin.gen_types.ex regenerates TypeScript types from plugin definitions, keeping the JS SDK in sync with server-side schema changes without manual type authoring.

intentions.title: Support backfill and data-migration of CMS documents from the command line
intentions.evidence: barkpark.media.backfill.ex backfills mediaAsset documents — a pattern for operating on existing CMS data outside the web lifecycle, enabling schema/model migrations without downtime.
